{
  "dataset_name": "pima_diabetes",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "glucose_bmi_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between normalized glucose and BMI, providing a non-linear feature for the linear model.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear SVM to capture the synergistic effect of high glucose and high BMI.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(plas / 199.0) * (mass / 67.1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Age standardized using training set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-1.05, 4.1],
      "feature_family": "scaling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Improves convergence and margin calculation in linear SVM by putting age on a similar scale to other features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 33.24) / 11.75"
    },
    {
      "name": "glucose_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Glucose standardized using training set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-3.8, 2.5],
      "feature_family": "scaling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ensures glucose variance does not dominate the SVM objective function.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(plas - 120.89) / 31.95"
    },
    {
      "name": "bmi_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "BMI standardized using training set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-4.1, 4.5],
      "feature_family": "scaling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes BMI for balanced margin penalization.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(mass - 31.99) / 7.88"
    },
    {
      "name": "pedigree_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed diabetes pedigree function to reduce right-skewness.",
      "value_range": [0.07, 1.25],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Makes the distribution of the pedigree function more symmetric, which is favorable for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(pedi)"
    },
    {
      "name": "insulin_glucose_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of insulin to glucose, capturing the relative insulin response.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 846.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a physiological ratio that might be linearly separable from other states.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "insu / np.maximum(plas, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "metabolic_risk_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "A linear composite score summing normalized glucose, BMI, and age.",
      "value_range": [0.25, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Pre-computes a linear combination of known risk factors, providing a strong single feature for the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(plas / 199.0) + (mass / 67.1) + (age / 81.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "pregnancies_per_year",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Number of pregnancies divided by estimated reproductive years (age - 12).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes pregnancy count by age, creating a more comparable rate feature across different ages.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "preg / np.maximum(age - 12.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "blood_pressure_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of blood pressure from the training set mean, scaled by standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.6],
      "feature_family": "deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures abnormality in blood pressure (both high and low) as a single continuous severity measure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(pres - 69.11) / 19.34"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_missing_insulin_skin",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator variable for rows where both insulin and skin thickness are zero (likely missing data).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "missingness",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear model to apply a specific bias offset for records with this pattern of missing data.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((insu == 0) & (skin == 0), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "clinical_severity_assessment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of overall clinical severity based on the combination of glucose, BMI, blood pressure, and age.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures complex, non-linear clinical heuristics that a linear SVM cannot easily deduce from raw features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "lifestyle_intervention_priority",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of how urgently lifestyle intervention is needed, evaluating BMI, blood pressure, and glucose levels.",
      "value_range": [1.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an ordinal severity scale that aligns well with linear margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
